rule: A V0 failure, a cut reply, or any other request without a valid read is a missing cell. The primary test leaves it out. The worst case scores it in the direction that shrinks the paired difference.
note: family = the two registered tests: parts nat (213 open dialogues) and hot (77 specific dialogues), forms t_legacy and t_renamed, 7 models: 7 x 290 x 2 = 4,060 first answers. Only first answers have stored reasons; the repeat answers of 20% of the dialogues are not counted here.
